subject: Defining parameter sizes dynamically with another parameter?

messages.author: 62e04143d03e3e71
messages.subject: Defining parameter sizes dynamically with another parameter?
parts:
Dear all,

I am curious if the following is possible: I wish to use a discrete int parameter (highlighted in pink) to define the size of other parameters (highlighted in yellow). Or in some way allow the size of the those other parameters to be defined dynamically without hard-coding the size as data beforehand.

Here is my code: 

data 
{
  int N;
  int a[N];
  vector[N] d;
  vector[N] conf;
}

parameters 
{
  real k;
  real c;
  int<lower=1> dim;
  vector[dim] x[N];
}

transformed parameters 
{

  matrix[dim, dim] Sigma;
  vector[dim] mu[N];
  vector[dim] mu_absent;
  vector[dim] prob_x_dT;
  real prob_x_dN;
  vector<lower=0,upper=1>[N] model_conf;
  
  Sigma <- diag_matrix(rep_vector(1,dim));
  mu_absent <- rep_vector(0,dim);
  
  
  for (i in 1:N) 
  {
    mu[i] <- rep_vector(0,dim);
    mu[i][1] <- d[i]*k;
    
    for (j in 1:dim)
    {
      prob_x_dT[j] <- exp(multi_normal_log(x[i], Sigma[j], Sigma)); // Using Sigma[j] to reference a I[j,]
    }
    
    prob_x_dN <- exp(multi_normal_log(x[i], mu_absent, Sigma));
    
    if (a[i] == 1) 
    {
      model_conf[i] <- prob_x_dT[1]/(prob_x_dN + sum(prob_x_dT));
    }
    if (a[i] == 0) 
    {
      model_conf[i] <- prob_x_dN/(prob_x_dN + sum(prob_x_dT));      
    }
  }
}

model 
{
  // hyperparameters
  k ~ normal(0, 10);
  c ~ normal(0, 10);

  // sample X from N-dimensional multivariate normal 
  x ~ multi_normal(mu, Sigma);
  for (i in 1:N) 
  {
    a[i] ~ bernoulli_logit(100*(x[i,1]-c));
  }
  conf ~ normal(model_conf, 0.025);
}

This code doesn't work, and I suspect it's because you can't dynamically allocate the size of parameters from another parameter defined in the parameters block, but I don't know for sure. 
If anyone could shed some light on the possibility of this, that would be amazing.

Many thanks,
Jason

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: Defining parameter sizes dynamically with another parameter?
parts:
On Monday, May 9, 2016 at 9:04:08 AM UTC-4, Jason Carpenter wrote:
This code doesn't work, and I suspect it's because you can't dynamically allocate the size of parameters from another parameter defined in the parameters block, but I don't know for sure.

You can't declare integer unknowns in the parameters block or the transformed parameters block. But integers known at runtime (and thus declared in the data block or the transformed data block) can be used in size declarations in the subsequent blocks.

Ben
